q: What should we say about carbon in our company profile or pitch deck?
title: Carbon line in a company profile
short: One or two sentences you can prove: what you measure, for which year, and one real action. For example, Scope 1 and 2 measured from our bills for 2025-26, and a figure you can share on request. Leave out green, eco friendly or neutral unless you can back them up.
audience: MSMEs writing a profile for buyers or investors

ul: We measure Scope 1 and 2 from our electricity and fuel bills each year.
Our 2025-26 footprint and method are available on request.
We cut diesel use by fitting a new compressor in 2025.
Eco friendly or green, with no detail.
Carbon neutral, without the offset evidence.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.
